title: Issue Review — cross-pass aggregate
description: Aggregate of N single-pass reviews for one ATDD parent issue. Lives at `.atdd/runtime/issue-reviews/<N>/aggregate.json` (issue #483 runtime layout). Read by the §4.2 pre-coach precondition: `unanimous-pass` proceeds; `mixed-verdict` triggers judge call site #5 (per #O3); `unanimous-concern` (or any pass surfacing a systemic concern, per spec §6.10) routes to BLOCKED.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this aggregate was last (re)written.

passes.description: Identity of every pass folded into this aggregate; lets a re-run reproduce the same input set deterministically.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension aggregate verdict — `concern` if any pass said `concern` for that dimension; `pass` only when every pass said `pass`.

verdict.description: Top-level routing label per spec §6.10. `unanimous-pass`: every pass said `pass` on every dimension. `unanimous-concern`: every pass surfaced ≥1 concern on the same dimension OR any pass surfaced a systemic concern (systemic dominates). `mixed-verdict`: anything else — passes disagreed.

findings.description: All findings across all passes, deduplicated by (rule_id, detail) when both are populated, otherwise listed individually. Each finding records the source pass for traceability.

concern_passes.description: pass_id of every pass that flagged this dimension as `concern`. Empty when verdict=pass.
